zh-CN.title: 猫咪头像框尺寸微调
items: Niko 与 Fufu 的招呼和击掌动画缩小至当前尺寸的一半
底部居中钻出、完整 8 帧动作和退回消失保持不变
动画仍保持每 10 秒播放一次

en.title: Refined cat avatar greeting size
items: Niko and Fufu greeting animations are now half their previous size
The centered entrance, full eight-frame motion, and retreat remain unchanged
